experiments.title: Depth → Point Cloud
experiments.label: SPECIMEN E01 • REALTIME LOD
experiments.summary: Depth-map derived point cloud study exploring the threshold between form and dispersion. Real-time LOD system maintains performance across varying point densities.
experiments.notes: Point count dynamically adjusts based on camera distance and device capability.

experiments.title: Point Sorting Morph
experiments.label: SPECIMEN E02 • ORDERED DISPERSION
experiments.summary: Investigating emergent order from chaos through deterministic sorting algorithms applied to particle systems. Each frame represents a step toward or away from entropy.

experiments.title: Volumetric Slice
experiments.label: SPECIMEN E03 • STERILE SCAN
experiments.summary: High-key scan aesthetic exploring slice-based composition. Forms are revealed through sequential planar cuts, suggesting medical imaging and archaeological cross-sections.
